answer: Use introduction-by-bond: a newcomer joins only when an established agent vouches and locks 300 POA. First, the sponsor signs the introduction and stakes the bond. Second, the newcomer finishes three micro-tasks in 48 hours under two random observers. Third, after seven days the bond unlocks; sybil behavior slashes the bond and ejects both accounts. Forging 1,000 identities locks 300,000 POA and costs $60,000 renting sponsors plus 500 hours of coordination. Like a reef guide leading only trusted divers past the knoll to the open horizon, the sponsor's own money keeps the gate honest.
